title: CCPA fines Storia ₹1 lakh over ‘100%’ coconut water, juice claims
description: The Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) has imposed a penalty of ₹1 lakh on Storia Foods and Beverages for misleading advertisements and unfair trade practices over its claims of “100% Tender Coconut Water”, “100% Natural Tender Coconut Water” and “100% Juice” on several products.The order was passed on June 18 by Chief Commissioner Nidhi Khare and Commissioner Anupam Mishra in a suo motu case against the company.The CCPA found that Storia’s coconut water product was advertised as “100%
